item.title: TheWorxHub - Access Issue for Canadian clients [investigating]
item.description:
We are continuing to investigate an issue that is preventing Canadian clients from accessing TheWorxHub using 'clientname.theworxhub.ca' URLs.
At this time, we cannot confirm whether the previous URL will be restored, so users should use the currently supported URL going forward to ensure uninterrupted access: 'clientname.theworxhub.com'
We recommend updating any bookmarks, shortcuts, or saved links to the supported URL above. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and understand how important consistent access is for your teams. We are taking this seriously and are strengthening our internal domain management processes to help prevent similar issues going forward. We will share additional updates as we have more information. item.title: MySchoolBuilding - Login Issue [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue with users not being able to access MySchoolBuilding. If you are still experiencing this issue, please clear your browser's cache and try again by going to https://login.myschoolbuilding.com/msb or https://www.myschoolbuilding.com/msb. While the change is in place, DNS updates can take some time to fully propagate. Because of this, you may continue to see the issue for a short period. If you need further assistance please contact support@brightlysoftware.com. Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.
